decisionsTitle: «Ghid de mărimi»: the supplier's size-chart picture, opened from beside the size select
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11, ordering a shirt in the members' zone:** «vreau să pun un tooltip cu o poză pentru ghid mărimi». The supplier's sheet is a drawing — chest width, length, per size — and §700's numbers-per-size table does not replace it.

**Decision.** A product carries one optional picture, its «Ghid de mărimi»: `shop_products.size_guide_media_asset_id` (a stored picture of the gallery, `ON DELETE SET NULL`) and `size_guide_crop` (the four fractions of §541, null for the whole picture), migration `0140`, expand only. In the editor it is a field under «Mărimile» (`ProductSizesCard`): the picture field of «Echipa» and the pictures card (`TeamPhotoField`, given its own field stem `sizeGuide` so a second picture field can share the product's form, and told to start the picture whole — a drawing must not lose its edges to the person photo's default square), posted as `sizeGuideAssetId` and `sizeGuideCrop`, saved with the product under its version and audit row (`sizeGuide: true|false`, never a title). `fields.ts` accepts a UUID or empty; a bad id or crop is refused naming the picture's box; the service refuses an id that is no stored picture. An empty field clears both columns.

In the members' zone, when a guide is set and the product has a size select, a «Ghid de mărimi» button stands beside the select on a laptop and under it on a phone (44 px, the ruler glyph by registry name). Pressing it opens the picture large through the house's picture lightbox of §601 — the ladder `srcset`, pinch-zoom, Back and Escape close — with alt «Ghid de mărimi — <product title>». The lightbox gained an optional `crop` and the picture's size, so a cropped guide opens as the club cropped it. The picture is counted by `media/references.ts` (the sweep, the delete guard and «used by» on the pictures page, as the members' page, like the strip's).

**Why a press and not a tooltip.** Members order from phones, where a hover does not exist; a tooltip-only picture would be invisible to most of them. The hover preview the brief allowed as a bonus is not built: MUI's `Tooltip` is a client island that clones its child with a ref, which the lightbox's island does not forward, and the picture inside a tooltip's title would be an element prop from a Server Component (§370) — a second island for the one device that matters least. The lightbox alone is the answer.

**Refused.** A tooltip-only picture (no touch). A picture per size (one drawing covers them all; the per-size numbers stay in the chart). Replacing the numeric chart (the chart stays for suppliers who give numbers). Amends §700.
changelogLine: - **«Ghid de mărimi» on a product** — the supplier's size-chart picture, chosen per product under «Mărimile», opens large from a button beside the size select in the members' shop, with pinch-zoom. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: A product's save, by a role that may manage the shop, keeps one optional «Ghid de mărimi» picture with its crop in `shop_products.size_guide_media_asset_id` / `size_guide_crop` — an id that is no UUID or no stored picture, or a crop that is no box, is refused naming the picture's box, an empty field clears both, and the pictures page counts the picture as the shop's and refuses to delete it (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The members' zone draws the «Ghid de mărimi» button beside a product's size select, opening the picture in the picture lightbox with the ladder `srcset` and the crop, only while the product has a guide picture and a size select (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
